Integrating these decompositions gives the selected logarithm and arctangent expressions; x/(2sqrt(5))=sqrt(5)x/10 and x/sqrt(3)=sqrt(3)x/3 explain the displayed arctangent forms. q-3617 decomposes as 2/(x-1)+(x+2)/(x^2+4x-1); the second numerator is half the denominator's derivative. q-3638 decomposes as (10x-15)/(2x^2-6x+9)-5/(x-4); the first numerator is 5/2 times the quadratic's derivative, and that quadratic is always positive. q-14770 uses the inverse derivative formula: f'(0)=4, hence (f^(-1))'(10)=1/4.
